title: Running
intro: Lines for runs with friends, the running club, a race, and the chat afterwards. Hardlopen is a split verb, so this lesson gives you lots of practice with it.

notes.title: Hardlopen splits: ik loop hard
body: Hardlopen is running as a sport. In a simple sentence, hard goes to the end: ik loop elke zondag hard.
After ga, wil or moet, it stays in one piece: ik ga hardlopen. The past form is hardgelopen, with heb.
Runners also just say lopen: ik heb tien kilometer gelopen.

notes.title: Distances and times
body: After a number, kilometer and uur stay singular: tien kilometer, twee uur. Minuut does change: vijf minuten.
Dutch writes a comma where English writes a decimal point. A half marathon is 21,1 kilometer: eenentwintig komma een.

cards.nl: Ik loop drie keer per week hard.
cards.en: I go running three times a week.
cards.rule: hardlopen splits: hard goes to the end.
After ga, hardlopen stays in one piece.

cards.en: Shall we go for a run together on Saturday?
cards.rule: An idea for both of you: Zullen we…?

cards.en: How far do you usually run?

cards.nl: Ik heb vanochtend tien kilometer gelopen.
cards.en: I ran ten kilometres this morning.
alts: Vanochtend heb ik tien kilometer gelopen.
cards.rule: Only the activity, no place you went to, so use heb.

cards.nl: Ik train voor een halve marathon.
cards.en: I'm training for a half marathon.

cards.nl: Ik heb me ingeschreven voor de tien kilometer.
cards.en: I've signed up for the ten kilometre race.
cards.rule: inschrijven in the past: ge- in the middle, ingeschreven.

reply.nl: Om tien uur, bij het stadion.

cards.nl: Ik sta morgen om zes uur op.
cards.en: I'm getting up at six tomorrow.
alts: Morgen sta ik om zes uur op.
cards.rule: opstaan: op goes to the end.
Two verbs: rekken goes to the end.

cards.en: Can you run a bit slower?
cards.rule: Question with two verbs: kun first, lopen at the end.

cards.nl: Ik heb een persoonlijk record gelopen!
cards.rule: Past: heb second, gelopen at the end.

cards.nl: Het regent, maar ik ga toch.
cards.en: It's raining, but I'm going anyway.

cards.nl: Ik ben lid van een hardloopclub.
cards.en: I'm a member of a running club.

cards.rule: You name the place you went to, so use ben.

readings.title: Zondag: de Stadsloop
text: Zondag is er geen gewone training, want dan is de Stadsloop. Wie meedoet, verzamelt om half tien bij de ingang van het park.
Je startnummer haal je zaterdag op bij de sportwinkel. Vergeet niet om het op je shirt te spelden!
Na de finish drinken we samen koffie in de kantine. Veel succes allemaal!
translation: There's no normal training on Sunday, because that's the day of the city run. If you're taking part, meet at half past nine at the park entrance.
Pick up your race number at the sports shop on Saturday. Don't forget to pin it on your shirt!
After the finish we'll have coffee together in the clubhouse. Good luck, everyone!

questions.q: Why is there no normal training on Sunday?
What time do the runners meet?
Where do you pick up your race number?
